Question 11(a) [2 marks]: Outline the impact that variety will have on the operations processes for this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Snowy Ice-Creams Pty Ltd is opening a new store in the city. They plan on purchasing machinery to make all products on site. They will be selling 30 different flavours of ice-cream varieties as well as several cake desserts.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Sketches in general terms the impact of variety on the operations process of Snowy Ice-Creams Pty Ltd
1 marks: May reference an impact of variety on the operations process of Snowy Ice-Creams Pty Ltd

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Variety refers to the range of products made by the business. With a wide variety of products being served the business is able to offer greater choice to customers. The variation in the transformation process may include new machinery, systems and procedures. This will cost the business money in terms of training and resources, therefore impacting profitability. However, this will enable the business to have a wider target market, leading to more customers, greater sales and improved profitability.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Definition of the key term plus any one of: cost increase; storage; use of technology; increased training; increased resources; greater choice to customers; positive and negative impacts; wider target market; increased customer base; greater sales.
